messages.message: PHPDoc tag @var for constant Oversized::ROWS with type list<list<int>> is incompatible with value non-empty-list<non-empty-list<bool|float|int|(literal-string&non-falsy-string)|null>>.
PHPDoc tag @var for constant Oversized::KEYED with type array<string, string> is incompatible with value non-empty-array<literal-string&non-falsy-string, int>.
Method Oversized::spread() should return list<array<int, string>> but returns non-empty-list<non-empty-list<bool|float|int|(literal-string&non-falsy-string)|null>>.
Method Oversized::keyed() should return array<int, string> but returns array<string, int>.
